Defenses to attempt


ImpossibilityLegal - intended act would not be criminal if completed Factual (no defense) - unknown condition prevents completion of intended crime
AbandonmentMajority/common law (no defense) - attempt complete once overt act committed Minority/MPC - voluntary & complete withdrawal from crime
MPC = Model Penal Code.

A defendant is guilty of an attempted crime if he/she had the specific intent to commit a crime, performed an overt act in furtherance of that crime, but did not complete it. This is true even when an unknown condition makes it factually impossible to complete the intended crime. Therefore, factual impossibility is never a defense to attempt.

Here, the neighbor did not have the specific intent to sell cocaine because he knew that the white powder was not cocaine. Therefore, he is not guilty of this attempted crime (Choices A & B). In contrast, the woman believed that the white powder was cocaine when she repackaged it and sold some to an undercover police officer. And though it was factually impossible for her to actually sell cocaine, this is no defense to attempt. As a result, only the woman is guilty of attempting to sell cocaine (Choice D).

Educational objective: Attempt requires proof that the defendant (1) had the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) performed an overt act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) did not complete it. And the defendant can be convicted of attempt even if it was factually impossible to complete the intended crime.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 2%，C选项 68%（正确选项），D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

未遂罪的抗辩理由


不能犯 (Impossibility)法律上的不能犯 - 即便完成，其意图行为也不构成犯罪
事实上的不能犯 (不能作为抗辩理由) - 未知情况阻碍了意图犯罪的完成
中止犯 (Abandonment)多数派/普通法 (不能作为抗辩理由) - 一旦实施明显行为，未遂即告成立
少数派/MPC - 自愿且完全地中止犯罪
MPC = Model Penal Code (模范刑法典)。

如果被告具有实施犯罪的特定意图，为促进该犯罪而实施了明显行为 (overt act)，但未能完成犯罪，则被告犯有未遂罪。即便存在未知情况导致事实上不可能完成意图的犯罪，这一点仍然成立。因此，事实上的不能犯从来都不是未遂罪的有效抗辩理由。

在本案中，邻居没有贩卖可卡因的特定意图，因为他知道白色粉末不是可卡因。因此，他没有犯此项未遂罪（排除了选项 A 和 B）。相反，当女子重新包装白色粉末并将其部分出售给卧底警察时，她相信那是可卡因。而且，尽管她事实上不可能真的售出可卡因，但这并不能作为未遂罪的抗辩理由。因此，只有该女子犯有贩卖可卡因未遂罪（排除了选项 D）。

教学目的：未遂罪要求证明被告 (1) 具有实施犯罪的特定意图，(2) 为促进该犯罪而实施了明显行为，但 (3) 未能完成犯罪。并且，即使事实上不可能完成意图的犯罪，被告也可能被判未遂罪。

MBE 考点解析

未遂罪 (Attempt) 与 不能犯 (Impossibility)
正确答案：C 邻居无罪，女子有罪。

本题考察的是刑法中未遂罪 (Attempt) 的两个核心要素：特定意图 (Specific Intent) 和 事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)。

未遂罪的构成要件 Elements of Attempt

根据普通法和模范刑法典 (MPC)，未遂罪需要满足两个条件：

  1. 特定意图 (Specific Intent)：被告必须主观上明确想要实施该犯罪行为。
  2. 明显行为 (Overt Act)：被告实施了超越“单纯准备”的行为，向犯罪完成迈出了实质性的一步。

案情详细分析

1. 邻居 (The Neighbor)
判定：无罪 (Not Guilty)

理由：缺乏特定意图 (Lack of Specific Intent)。

虽然邻居卖了粉末，但他明知那不是可卡因。因此，他主观上并没有“贩卖受控物质”的意图。他可能犯有诈骗罪 (Fraud) 或盗窃罪 (Theft by deception)，但在“贩卖可卡因未遂”这一特定指控上，由于缺乏该罪名的特定犯罪意图，他不能被定罪。

2. 女子 (The Woman)
判定：有罪 (Guilty)

理由：事实上的不能犯不是抗辩理由 (Factual Impossibility is no defense)。

  • 意图：她相信那是可卡因，并且意图出售。她具备了特定意图。
  • 行为：她购买、分装并出售给警察。这构成了明显行为。
  • 抗辩无效：虽然事实上那不是毒品（导致犯罪在客观上不可能完成），但这属于事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)。在刑法中，只要被告认为事实如其所想便能构成犯罪，那么事实上的障碍不能作为未遂罪的抗辩理由。
不能犯的类型辨析 Impossibility Defenses

MBE 常考陷阱：区分“事实不能”与“法律不能”。

  • 事实上的不能犯 (Factual Impossibility)：
    ❌ 不是抗辩理由 (有罪)。
    例子：想偷钱但这人口袋是空的；想杀人但枪里没子弹；想卖毒品但那是面粉（本题情况）。
  • 法律上的不能犯 (Legal Impossibility)：
    ✅ 是抗辩理由 (无罪)。
    例子：被告认为自己在犯罪，但实际上法律并没有禁止该行为。例如，某人打猎时以为该季节禁止打猎（意图偷猎），但实际上法律允许此时打猎。因为行为本身合法，即便他有“犯罪心理”，也不构成未遂。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理未遂罪 (Attempt) 题目时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 先看主观意图 (Mens Rea)：如果被告知道事实真相（如邻居知道是假药），就没有特定意图，直接排除未遂罪。
  2. 再看客观障碍：如果被告有犯罪意图，但因客观原因失败（如买到假药、枪支故障），这是“事实上的不能犯”，必须判有罪。

A businesswoman decided to destroy an old warehouse that she owned because the taxes on the structure exceeded the income that she could receive from it. She crept into the building in the middle of the night with a can of gasoline and a fuse and set the fuse timer for 30 minutes. She then left the building. The fuse failed to ignite, and the building was not harmed.
Arson is defined in this jurisdiction as "the intentional burning of any building or structure of another, without the consent of the owner." The businesswoman believed, however, that burning one's own building was arson, having been so advised by her lawyer.
Has the businesswoman committed attempted arson?

choices.a: No, because even if her actions had every consequence she intended, they would not have constituted arson.
choices.b: No, because her mistake negated a necessary mental state.
choices.c: Yes, because a mistake of law even on the advice of an attorney is no defense.
choices.d: Yes, because factual impossibility is no defense.

Q84085

A businesswoman decided to destroy an old warehouse that she owned because the taxes on the structure exceeded the income that she could receive from it. She crept into the building in the middle of the night with a can of gasoline and a fuse and set the fuse timer for 30 minutes. She then left the building. The fuse failed to ignite, and the building was not harmed.

Arson is defined in this jurisdiction as "the intentional burning of any building or structure of another, without the consent of the owner." The businesswoman believed, however, that burning one's own building was arson, having been so advised by her lawyer.

Has the businesswoman committed attempted arson?

一名女商人决定摧毁她所拥有的一座旧仓库，因为该建筑的税收超过了她能从中获得的收入。她在半夜带着一罐汽油和一根引信潜入该建筑，并将引信的定时器设置为30分钟。然后她离开了该建筑。引信未能点燃，建筑也未受损害。

在该司法管辖区，纵火罪（Arson）被定义为“未经所有者同意，故意焚烧他人的任何建筑物或构筑物。”然而，该女商人相信焚烧自己的建筑也构成纵火罪，因为她的律师是这样告知她的。

该女商人是否构成了纵火未遂罪？
options:
A. No, because even if her actions had every consequence she intended, they would not have constituted arson.
否，因为即使她的行为产生了她所意图的所有后果，她的行为也不会构成纵火罪。

B. No, because her mistake negated a necessary mental state.
否，因为她的错误排除了必要的犯罪意图（mental state）。

C. Yes, because a mistake of law even on the advice of an attorney is no defense.
是，因为法律上的错误，即使是基于律师的建议，也不能作为抗辩理由。

D. Yes, because factual impossibility is no defense.
是，因为事实不能（factual impossibility）不能作为抗辩理由。
data.explanation:
Defenses to attempt


Impossibility
Legalintended act would not be criminal if completed
Factual (no defense)unknown condition prevents completion of intended crime
Abandonment
Majority/common law (no defense)attempt complete once overt act committed
Minority/MPCvoluntary & complete withdrawal from crime

MPC = Model Penal Code.

Attempt occurs when a person:

  • has the specific intent to commit a crime
  • performs an overt act in furtherance of the intended crime
  • but does not complete it.

Legal impossibility is a defense to attempt if the intended act would not be criminal even if completed. That is because it is no crime to commit an act that is not a crime.

Here, the businesswoman decided to burn down her warehouse (specific intent). She crept into the warehouse with a can of gasoline and a fuse, then set a fuse timer (overt acts). However, the fuse did not ignite (incomplete crime). But even if she had successfully burned her warehouse, this jurisdiction limits arson to the intentional burning of another's building. Therefore, her attempted act would not have been criminal even if completed (legal impossibility).

(Choice B) A defendant's honest but mistaken belief is a defense to specific intent crimes (eg, attempt) when that belief negates the specific intent (ie, mistake of fact). But since the businesswoman's mistaken belief did not prevent her from forming the specific intent to burn down her warehouse, it is not a defense here.

(Choice C) Mistake or ignorance of the law is almost never a defense to criminal liability - even when a person relies on the advice of an attorney. But the businesswoman did not commit attempted arson because her intended act (even if completed) would not amount to arson in this jurisdiction.

(Choice D) Factual impossibility arises when an unknown fact or circumstance prevents the defendant from completing the intended crime (eg, the malfunctioning fuse) and is never a defense to attempt. But legal impossibility (eg, burning one's building) is always a defense to attempt.

Educational objective: Legal impossibility is a defense to attempt when a person's intended act would not constitute a crime if completed.



选项正确率统计：A选项 79%（正确选项），B选项 7%，C选项 8%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

犯罪未遂的抗辩


不能犯（Impossibility）
法律不能（Legal）即使完成，意图的行为也不构成犯罪
事实不能（Factual）（非抗辩理由）未知的条件阻碍了意图犯罪的完成
中止犯（Abandonment）
多数/普通法（非抗辩理由）一旦实施了公开行为，未遂即告成立
少数/MPC自愿且完全地中止犯罪

MPC = Model Penal Code.

当一个人实施以下行为时，即构成犯罪未遂（Attempt）：

  • 具有实施犯罪的特定意图（specific intent）
  • 为促成意图的犯罪而实施了公开行为（overt act）
  • 但未能完成该罪行。

法律不能（Legal impossibility）是一种对犯罪未遂的抗辩，适用于当意图的行为即使完成也不构成犯罪的情况。这是因为实施一个不构成犯罪的行为本身不是犯罪。

在本案中，女商人决定烧毁她的仓库（特定意图）。她带着一罐汽油和一根引信潜入仓库，然后设置了引信定时器（公开行为）。然而，引信没有点燃（犯罪未完成）。但即使她成功烧毁了她自己的仓库，该司法管辖区也将纵火罪限定为故意焚烧他人的建筑物。因此，即使她完成了她意图的行为，该行为也不构成犯罪（法律不能）。

（选项B）当被告善意但错误的认知排除了特定意图时（即事实错误，mistake of fact），这种认知可以作为对特定意图犯罪（例如，犯罪未遂）的抗辩。但由于该女商人的错误认知并未妨碍她形成烧毁自己仓库的特定意图，因此在此案中不能作为抗辩理由。

（选项C）对法律的错误理解或无知几乎从不构成刑事责任的抗辩——即使当事人是依据律师的建议行事。但该女商人并未构成纵火未遂罪，因为她意图的行为（即使完成）在该司法管辖区内也不构成纵火罪。

（选项D）当某个未知的实际情况或情形阻碍被告完成其意图的犯罪时（例如，引信失灵），就产生了事实不能（Factual impossibility），而事实不能绝不能作为犯罪未遂的抗辩。但法律不能（例如，焚烧自己的建筑物）则始终可以作为犯罪未遂的抗辩。

教学目标：当一个人意图的行为即使完成也不构成犯罪时，法律不能（Legal impossibility）可作为对犯罪未遂的抗辩。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Attempt & Impossibility
核心考点：不能犯 (Impossibility)

本题考察的是刑法未遂理论中“法律不能” (Legal Impossibility) 与 “事实不能” (Factual Impossibility) 的区别。

关键规则对比

在普通法 (Common Law) 中，这两种情况的法律后果截然不同：

类型 定义 是否构成抗辩?
法律不能
Legal Impossibility 		即使被告完成了所有意图的行为，该行为在法律上并不构成犯罪。 是 (Yes)
无罪
事实不能
Factual Impossibility 		被告意图实施犯罪，但因未知的物理事实或环境导致无法完成。 否 (No)
构成未遂

📝 案情拆解

  • 意图 (Intent)： 女商人想烧毁仓库。
  • 所有权 (Ownership)： 仓库是她自己的。
  • 法律定义 (Statute)： 纵火罪 = 烧毁他人 (of another) 的建筑。
  • 意外 (The Glitch)： 引信失灵 (Fuse failed)。

这里存在两个层面的“不可能”：

  1. 事实层面： 引信坏了，火没烧起来。（这是事实不能）
  2. 法律层面： 即使火烧起来了，烧自己的房子也不符合该州“纵火罪”的定义。（这是法律不能）

✅ 正确答案：A

"No, because even if her actions had every consequence she intended, they would not have constituted arson."

深度解析：

本题的决定性因素是法律不能 (Legal Impossibility)。

虽然引信失灵是一个事实障碍（Factual Impossibility），通常不能作为抗辩理由（即如果烧别人的房子引信坏了，仍构成未遂）。

但是，本案中有一个更根本的问题：目标本身不构成犯罪。在该司法管辖区，纵火罪必须是烧毁“他人”的财产。既然她烧的是自己的财产，即使她成功了，她也没有犯下纵火罪。

既然完成行为都不构成犯罪，那么“试图”完成该行为自然也不构成犯罪未遂。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 B (Mistake of Fact)： 错误。她没有事实认识错误（她知道那是自己的仓库）。她的错误是认为烧自己仓库犯法，这是法律认识错误。
  • 选项 C (Mistake of Law)： 这是一个陷阱。虽然“不知法不免责”是原则，但这里不是她在用“不知法”来脱罪，而是她的行为客观上根本就不违法。她误以为自己犯法了（幻觉犯罪），但这不能让一个合法行为变成犯罪。
  • 选项 D (Factual Impossibility)： 错误。虽然引信失灵确实是事实不能，但本案存在更上位的“法律不能”抗辩。如果她去烧邻居的房子且引信失灵，选项D就是正确理由（构成未遂）。但因为她烧的是自己的房子，法律不能优先适用。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
做未遂题目时，先问自己：
“如果被告手中的魔杖一挥，一切如愿发生，这事儿犯法吗？”
如果不犯法，那就是法律不能，无罪。

A man was angry at a coworker who had received a promotion. The man believed that the coworker had taken credit for the man's work and had bad-mouthed him to their boss. One day, as the man was leaving the company parking lot in his car, he saw the coworker walking through the lot. On a sudden impulse, the man pushed the accelerator pedal hard and veered toward the coworker with the intention of scaring him. The coworker tried to jump out of the way but slipped and fell and was run over. Although the coworker suffered life-threatening injuries, he survived.
In a jurisdiction that follows the common law of homicide, could the man properly be convicted of attempted murder?

choices.a: No, because the coworker's slip and fall broke the chain of proximate causation.
choices.b: No, because the man lacked the requisite intent.
choices.c: Yes, because the coworker suffered life-threatening injuries.
choices.d: Yes, because the man acted with reckless disregard for human life.

On a sudden impulse, the man pushed the accelerator pedal hard and veered toward the coworker with the intention of scaring him. The coworker tried to jump out of the way but slipped and fell and was run over. Although the coworker suffered life-threatening injuries, he survived.

In a jurisdiction that follows the common law of homicide, could the man properly be convicted of attempted murder? 一名男子对自己升职的同事感到愤怒。该男子认为同事抢了他的功劳，并在老板面前说他的坏话。一天，当该男子开车离开公司停车场时，他看到同事正穿过停车场。一时冲动之下，该男子猛踩油门，将车转向同事，意图吓唬他。同事试图跳开，但滑倒并被车碾过。虽然同事身受重伤，有生命危险，但他活了下来。

在一个遵循普通法杀人罪（homicide）的司法管辖区，该男子是否可以被正式定为谋杀未遂罪？

B. No, because the man lacked the requisite intent.

C. Yes, because the coworker suffered life-threatening injuries.
可以，因为同事遭受了危及生命的伤害。

D. Yes, because the man acted with reckless disregard for human life.
可以，因为该男子的行为鲁莽，罔顾他人生命。
data.explanation:
Attempt is an inchoate crime that requires proof that a defendant: had the specific intent to commit a crime (eg, murder) performed an overt act in furtherance of the intended crime but did not complete it. Therefore, attempted murder requires proof that the defendant specifically intended to kill the victim. This is true even though a completed murder can be established without showing an intent to kill—ie, when there is some other type of malice aforethought.

Here, the man cannot be convicted of attempted murder because he only intended to scare the coworker—not kill him. But had the coworker died, the man could have been convicted of murder since he acted with reckless disregard for human life (ie, malice aforethought) when he accelerated toward the coworker (Choice D).

(Choice A) Causation is relevant to crimes that require the occurrence of a particular result—eg, murder requires that the defendant cause the victim's death. But causation is irrelevant to attempt (and other inchoate crimes) since the intended result need not be completed. Therefore, the man is not guilty of attempted murder regardless of whether the coworker's slip and fall broke the chain of causation.

(Choice C) Although the coworker suffered life-threatening injuries, the man cannot be convicted of attempted murder since he lacked the specific intent to kill.

Educational objective: Attempt is a specific intent crime. Therefore, attempted murder requires proof that the defendant acted with the intent to kill—no other form of malice aforethought will suffice.



未遂（Attempt）是一种未完成的罪行（inchoate crime），需要证明被告： 具有实施某项犯罪的具体意图（specific intent to commit a crime）（例如，谋杀） 为促进意图实施的犯罪而采取了公开行为（overt act），但 未能完成该犯罪。 因此，谋杀未遂（attempted murder）要求证明被告有杀死受害人的具体意图。尽管在一个既遂的谋杀案中，即使没有杀人意图——即存在其他类型的预谋恶意（malice aforethought）——也可以定罪，但前述要求依然成立。

在本案中，该男子不能被判为谋杀未遂，因为他只打算吓唬同事，而不是杀死他。但如果同事死亡，该男子可能会被判为谋杀罪，因为当他加速冲向同事时，他的行为鲁莽，罔顾他人生命（即预谋恶意）（选项 D）。

（选项 A）因果关系（Causation）与要求特定结果发生的犯罪有关——例如，谋杀罪要求被告导致受害人死亡。但因果关系与未遂（以及其他未完成的罪行）无关，因为意图的结果不必完成。因此，无论同事的滑倒和摔倒是否中断了因果链，该男子都不构成谋杀未遂罪。

（选项 C）尽管同事遭受了危及生命的伤害，但由于该男子缺乏具体的杀人意图，他不能被判为谋杀未遂。

教学目的： 未遂是一种具体意图犯罪（specific intent crime）。因此，谋杀未遂要求证明被告有杀人意图——任何其他形式的预谋恶意都不足以构成此罪。

MBE 刑法考点解析

Attempted Murder & Specific Intent

正确答案：B
本题的核心考点在于区分既遂谋杀（Murder）与谋杀未遂（Attempted Murder）在主观意图（Mens Rea）要求上的巨大差异。
⚖️ 核心法律原则
未遂罪（Attempt）是特殊意图犯罪（Specific Intent Crime）。

这意味着，要判定某人犯有“谋杀未遂罪”，检方必须证明被告具有“杀死受害人的具体意图” (Specific intent to kill)。
仅仅证明被告行为鲁莽（Reckless）或具有造成严重身体伤害的意图是不够的，哪怕这些意图对于定罪“既遂谋杀”已经足够。
🔍 案情分析
题目中的事实非常明确：
  • 被告猛踩油门冲向同事。
  • 意图： "Intention of scaring him"（意图吓唬他）。
  • 结果： 同事受重伤但存活。
因为被告的目的是“吓唬”而非“杀害”，他缺乏构成谋杀未遂所必须的Specific Intent to Kill。因此，答案选 B。
🚫 为什么选项 D 是最大的陷阱？
选项 D 提到了 "Reckless disregard for human life"（罔顾人命的鲁莽）。

这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。如果受害人死了，这种鲁莽心态（即 Depraved Heart）足以支持谋杀罪（Murder）的定罪。

但是，受害人没死。对于未遂（Attempt），鲁莽（Recklessness）永远不足以定罪。
请记住这句法谚逻辑："You cannot attempt to do something unintentionally."（你不可能“试图”去做一件你并非有意为之的事情）。鲁莽本质上是非故意的，因此不存在“鲁莽的未遂”。
📊 考点对比表
罪名 所需的主观意图 (Mens Rea)
Common Law Murder
(既遂谋杀)		 1. Intent to kill (杀人意图)
2. Intent to cause serious bodily harm (重伤意图)
3. Depraved heart / Recklessness (极端鲁莽)
4. Felony murder (重罪谋杀)
Attempted Murder
(谋杀未遂)		 仅限：Intent to kill (杀人意图)
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 刑法题中，一旦看到 Charge 是 Attempt（未遂）：
  1. 立即寻找被告是否有Specific Intent（具体意图）去完成该罪行。
  2. 如果题目说被告只是“鲁莽”（Reckless）、“疏忽”（Negligent）或者是为了“吓唬”（Scare），直接排除未遂罪的定罪选项。
  3. 不要被受害人伤势的严重程度（如本题中的 Life-threatening injuries）误导，未遂看的是心（意图），而不是伤。

A man was charged with felony murder because of his involvement in a bank robbery. The evidence at trial disclosed that a coworker invited the man to go for a ride in her new car, and after a while asked him to drive. As they drove around town, the coworker explained to the man that she planned to rob the bank and that she needed him to drive the getaway car. The man agreed to drive to the bank and to wait outside while the coworker went in to rob it.
As they approached the bank, the man began to regret his agreement to help with the robbery. Once there, the coworker got out of the car. As she went out of sight inside the bank, the man drove away and went home. Inside the bank, the coworker killed a bank guard who tried to prevent her from leaving with the money. The coworker ran outside and, finding that her car and the man were gone, ran down an alley. She was apprehended a few blocks away. The man later turned himself in after hearing on the radio that the coworker had killed the guard.
The jurisdiction has a death penalty that applies to felony murder.
Consistent with the law and the Constitution, of which crime may the jury convict the man?

choices.a: Felony murder and impose the death penalty.
choices.b: Felony murder but not impose the death penalty.
choices.c: Bank robbery only.
choices.d: No crime.

一名男子因参与银行抢劫而被控重罪谋杀（felony murder）。庭审证据显示，一名同事邀请该男子乘坐她的新车，过了一会儿，同事让该男子开车。当他们在城里开车时，同事向该男子解释说，她计划抢劫银行，并需要他来开逃逸车辆。该男子同意开车到银行，并在同事进去抢劫时在外面等候。

当他们接近银行时，该男子开始后悔自己同意协助抢劫。到达银行后，同事下了车。在该同事进入银行，离开他的视线后，该男子开车离开并回了家。在银行内，同事杀死了一名试图阻止她带钱离开的银行警卫。同事跑到外面，发现她的车和该男子都不见了，于是跑进一条小巷。她在几个街区外被逮捕。该男子后来在收音机里听到同事杀害了警卫的消息后自首。

该司法管辖区对重罪谋杀适用死刑。

根据法律和宪法，陪审团可以判定该男子犯有何种罪行？
options:
A. Felony murder and impose the death penalty.
重罪谋杀，并处以死刑。

B. Felony murder but not impose the death penalty.
重罪谋杀，但不处以死刑。

C. Bank robbery only.
仅银行抢劫罪。

D. No crime.
无罪。
data.explanation:
Accomplice liability extends to any person who
  • intentionally aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime
  • with the specific intent that the crime be completed
Both parties are equally liable for the encouraged crime and any crimes that occur as a natural and probable (ie, foreseeable) consequence of that crime.

Here, the man became an accomplice when he drove his coworker to the bank so that she could rob it. The man then fled the crime scene and did not encourage the commission of felony murder - the killing of another during the commission, or attempted commission, of an inherently dangerous felony like robbery. But he is guilty of felony murder since the coworker killed a bank guard who tried to prevent her from taking the money - a foreseeable consequence of robbery (Choice D).

However, due to the Eighth Amendment prohibition against cruel and unusual punishment, the death penalty cannot be imposed on an accomplice to felony murder who did not kill or intend to kill - unless the accomplice significantly participated in the underlying felony and acted with reckless indifference to human life. And since the man merely dropped the coworker off at the bank, he did not significantly participate in the robbery. Therefore, the jury may convict him of felony murder but cannot impose the death penalty (Choice A).

(Choice C) In some jurisdictions, the underlying felony in a felony murder case may be treated as a lesser included offense that merges into the felony murder conviction for sentencing purposes. Here, even if the man could be convicted of bank robbery (lesser offense), his accomplice liability for the coworker's killing during the robbery supports a felony murder conviction (greater offense) — making a conviction for bank robbery only unlikely.

Educational objective: The death penalty cannot be imposed on an accomplice to felony murder who did not kill or intend to kill - unless the accomplice
  • significantly participated in the felony and
  • acted with reckless indifference to human life




选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 59%（正确选项），C选项 15%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

共犯责任适用于任何在犯罪前或犯罪期间
  • 故意帮助或教唆主犯
  • 并具有完成该罪行的特定意图
的人。双方对被教唆的罪行以及作为该罪行自然且可预见的后果而发生的任何罪行负有同等责任。

在本案中，该男子开车送同事去银行以便她抢劫时，他成为了共犯。该男子随后逃离犯罪现场，并且没有教唆实施重罪谋杀——即在实施或企图实施像抢劫这样内在危险的重罪期间杀害他人。但他犯有重罪谋杀罪，因为同事杀死了一名试图阻止她拿走钱的银行警卫——这是抢劫的可预见后果（因此选项D不正确）。

然而，根据《Eighth Amendment》禁止残酷和不寻常惩罚的规定，对于没有杀人或意图杀人的重罪谋杀共犯，不得判处死刑——除非该共犯重大参与了基础重罪，并且对人的生命表现出鲁莽的漠视。由于该男子仅是将同事送到银行，他并未重大参与抢劫。因此，陪审团可以判定他犯有重罪谋杀罪，但不能判处死刑（因此选项A不正确）。

（选项C）在某些法域中，重罪谋杀案件里的基础重罪可能被视为从属罪行（lesser included offense），在量刑时被吸收入重罪谋杀罪中。在本案中，即使该男子可能被判犯有银行抢劫罪（较轻罪行），但他作为共犯对同事在抢劫中的杀人行为承担责任，足以支持重罪谋杀罪的定罪（较重罪行）——因此仅判银行抢劫罪的可能性很低。

教学目标：对于没有杀人或意图杀人的重罪谋杀共犯，不得判处死刑——除非该共犯
  • 重大参与了该重罪，并且
  • 对人的生命表现出鲁莽的漠视


References

Enmund v. Florida, 458 U.S. 782, 790 - 91 (1982) (holding that the death penalty cannot be imposed on a felony-murder accomplice who did not kill or intend to kill).

Tison v. Arizona, 481 U.S. 137, 158 (1987) (imposing the death penalty on a felony-murder accomplice who was a major participant in the underlying felony and acted with reckless indifference to human life).

MBE 刑法考点解析

共犯责任、重罪谋杀与死刑的宪法限制

🎯 核心考点剖析

本题巧妙地融合了三个高频考点：

  • 共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability) 及撤回的有效性。
  • 重罪谋杀法则 (Felony Murder Rule)。
  • 第八修正案 (Eighth Amendment) 对重罪谋杀共犯适用死刑的限制。

⚖️ 法律规则与判例

1. 共犯的撤回 (Withdrawal)

共犯若想免除后续犯罪的责任，必须进行有效撤回。仅仅在心里后悔或默默离开现场是不够的。如果共犯已经提供了实质性帮助（如本案中开车送主犯到现场），他必须：

  • 设法收回其提供的帮助，或者
  • 在犯罪发生前及时报警 (notify authorities)。

本案中，男子仅是自己开车回家，未能阻止抢劫也未报警，因此撤回无效，仍需对抢劫及其可预见后果负责。

2. 重罪谋杀法则 (Felony Murder)

在实施内在危险重罪（如抢劫、强奸、绑架等）期间导致他人死亡，构成重罪谋杀。共犯不仅对基础重罪负责，还要对该重罪的自然且可预见的后果 (natural and probable consequences) 负责。抢劫银行导致警卫被杀，在法律上属于高度可预见的后果。

3. 宪法对死刑的限制 (Death Penalty Limits)

根据美国宪法第八修正案（禁止残酷和不寻常的惩罚），联邦最高法院通过两个经典判例确立了对重罪谋杀共犯判处死刑的规则：

Enmund v. Florida (1982):
一般原则：如果共犯没有亲手杀人、没有试图杀人、也没有杀人意图，不得对其判处死刑。
Tison v. Arizona (1987):
例外情况：如果共犯是基础重罪的重大参与者 (Major Participant)，并且对人类生命表现出鲁莽的漠视 (Reckless Indifference to Human Life)，则可以判处死刑。

🔍 案件逻辑推演

1 定罪分析：是否构成重罪谋杀？
男子同意并实际开车送同事去抢银行，确立了共犯身份。中途离开不构成有效撤回。同事在抢劫中杀害警卫是可预见后果。因此，男子构成重罪谋杀罪。
2 量刑分析：能否判处死刑？
男子没有杀人意图。他仅仅是把同事送到银行就离开了，既不是抢劫的“重大参与者”，也没有对生命表现出“鲁莽的漠视”（他甚至因为后悔而离开了）。
3 得出结论：
陪审团可以判定他犯有重罪谋杀罪 (Felony Murder)，但受宪法保护，不能对其判处死刑。
💡 MBE 考场实战技巧

在 MBE 刑法题中，当你看到以下要素同时出现：

  • Felony Murder (重罪谋杀)
  • Accomplice (共犯/未亲手杀人者)
  • Death Penalty (死刑)

👉 条件反射：立刻在脑海中搜索两个关键词："Major Participant" (重大参与) 和 "Reckless Indifference" (鲁莽漠视)。

如果题目事实（如本题）明确显示该共犯参与度很低（如仅充当外围司机且中途逃跑），直接排除包含死刑的选项。注意区分“定罪”(Conviction) 和“量刑”(Sentencing)，定罪看共犯理论，量刑看宪法限制。

questions.question:
A woman and her sister took a trip to the Caribbean. When they passed through U.S. Customs inspection upon their return, the customs officials found packages of cocaine stitched inside separate carry-on bags belonging to each of them. They were arrested. Upon separate questioning by customs officers, the woman broke down and cried, "I told my sister there were too many officers at this airport." The sister did not give a statement.
The woman and her sister were indicted for conspiracy to import cocaine. They were tried separately. At the woman's trial, after the government introduced the above evidence and rested its case, her lawyer moved for a judgment of acquittal on grounds of insufficient evidence.
Should the court grant the motion?

choices.a: No, because the evidence shows that both the woman and her sister agreed to import cocaine.
choices.b: No, because the evidence shows that both the woman and her sister possessed cocaine.
choices.c: Yes, because the evidence shows only that the woman and her sister committed separate crimes of cocaine possession.
choices.d: Yes, because the evidence shows that the woman effectively withdrew from the conspiracy when she cooperated by giving a statement.

data.questionStem:
Q84054

A woman and her sister took a trip to the Caribbean. When they passed through U.S. Customs inspection upon their return, the customs officials found packages of cocaine stitched inside separate carry-on bags belonging to each of them. They were arrested. Upon separate questioning by customs officers, the woman broke down and cried, "I told my sister there were too many officers at this airport." The sister did not give a statement.

The woman and her sister were indicted for conspiracy to import cocaine. They were tried separately. At the woman's trial, after the government introduced the above evidence and rested its case, her lawyer moved for a judgment of acquittal on grounds of insufficient evidence.

Should the court grant the motion?

一名女子和她的妹妹去加勒比地区旅行。当她们返回并通过U.S. Customs（美国海关）检查时，海关官员在她们各自的随身行李中发现了缝在里面的可卡因包裹。她们被逮捕了。在海关官员的分别讯问下，该女子崩溃大哭道：‘我告诉过我妹妹这个机场的官员太多了。’妹妹没有作出任何陈述。

该女子和她的妹妹因共谋进口可卡因而被起诉。她们被分案审理。在该女子的审判中，政府在提交了上述证据并结束其陈述后，她的律师以证据不足为由，请求作出无罪判决。

法院是否应批准该动议？
options:
A. No, because the evidence shows that both the woman and her sister agreed to import cocaine.
不应批准，因为证据表明该女子和她的妹妹都同意进口可卡因。

B. No, because the evidence shows that both the woman and her sister possessed cocaine.
不应批准，因为证据表明该女子和她的妹妹都持有可卡因。

C. Yes, because the evidence shows only that the woman and her sister committed separate crimes of cocaine possession.
应批准，因为证据仅表明该女子和她的妹妹分别犯有持有可卡因的罪行。

D. Yes, because the evidence shows that the woman effectively withdrew from the conspiracy when she cooperated by giving a statement.
应批准，因为证据表明该女子通过合作作出陈述，有效地退出了共谋。
data.explanation:
Conspiracy


AgreementOvert act
Majority view (modern & MPC)Unilateral approach - at least one person specifically intends to enter agreementAt least one conspirator must commit overt act
Minority view (common law)Bilateral approach - two or more persons specifically intend to enter agreementNot required
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Conspiracy requires proof that:
  • two or more persons entered an agreement (explicitly or implicitly) with the specific intent to commit a crime† and
  • in most jurisdictions, at least one conspirator committed an overt act in furtherance of that agreement.


Therefore, a court should grant a motion for acquittal if no rational trier of fact could find that the evidence, viewed in the light most favorable to the prosecution, establishes these elements beyond a reasonable doubt.

Here, there is no evidence of an explicit agreement (eg, express words). But a rational trier of fact could find evidence of an implicit agreement because (1) the statement that "I told my sister there were too many officers at this airport" and (2) the cocaine found inside the sisters' carry-on bags show their intent to jointly achieve a criminal objective - importing cocaine. Therefore, the court should deny the woman's motion for acquittal.

†Whether this jurisdiction follows the unilateral or bilateral approach to conspiracy is not stated. However, there is evidence that both women agreed and specifically intended to import cocaine, so either approach is satisfied under these facts.

(Choice B) Evidence that the sisters possessed cocaine also shows that they committed an overt act in furtherance of the conspiracy. But since an overt act is not an element of conspiracy in every jurisdiction, this is not the strongest basis for denying the woman's motion.

(Choice C) The evidence shows that the woman and her sister committed separate crimes of cocaine possession. But it also shows that they committed conspiracy - a distinct crime.

(Choice D) Withdrawal is only a defense to conspiracy after an overt act under the Model Penal Code, which requires that the defendant voluntarily renounce the conspiracy and thwart its success. Here, the woman's statement to customs officers did not prevent the import of cocaine, so she did not withdraw.

Educational objective: Conspiracy requires an agreement between two persons to commit a crime, but the agreement need not be express. It can be implied from conduct demonstrating an intent to jointly achieve a shared criminal objective.

选项正确率统计：A选项 67%（正确选项），B选项 12%，C选项 19%，D选项 0%

共谋罪


合意公开行为
多数观点 (现代 & MPC)单边理论 - 至少有一人明确意图达成协议至少一名共谋者必须实施公开行为
少数观点 (普通法)双边理论 - 两人或多人明确意图达成协议不要求
MPC = Model Penal Code (《模范刑法典》)。

共谋罪要求证明：
  • 两人或多人以实施犯罪为特定意图，达成一项协议（明示或默示）† 并且
  • 在多数司法管辖区，至少一名共谋者为推进该协议而实施了公开行为。


因此，如果一个理性的事实审判者，在以对控方最有利的方式看待证据后，无法毫无疑点地认定这些要素成立，那么法院就应批准无罪判决的动议。

在本案中，没有明示协议的证据（例如，明确的言辞）。但一个理性的事实审判者可以找到默示协议的证据，因为（1）‘我告诉过我妹妹这个机场的官员太多了’的陈述，以及（2）在姐妹俩的随身行李中发现的可卡因，都表明了她们共同实现一个犯罪目标——进口可卡因的意图。因此，法院应驳回该女子的无罪判决动议。

†本案未说明该司法管辖区在共谋罪上遵循单边理论还是双边理论。然而，有证据表明两名女子都同意并明确意图进口可卡因，因此在此案件事实下，两种理论的要求都得到满足。

(选项B) 姐妹俩持有可卡因的证据也表明她们为推进共谋实施了一项公开行为。但由于公开行为并非每个司法管辖区的共谋罪构成要素，因此这不是驳回该女子动议的最有力依据。

(选项C) 证据表明该女子和她的妹妹分别犯有持有可卡因的罪行。但证据也表明她们犯下了共谋罪——一个独立的罪名。

(选项D) 根据 Model Penal Code，只有在实施公开行为后，退出共谋才可作为抗辩理由，这要求被告人自愿放弃共谋并阻止其成功。在本案中，该女子对海关官员的陈述并未阻止可卡因的进口，因此她并未退出共谋。

教学目的：共谋罪要求两人之间有实施犯罪的协议，但该协议不必是明示的。它可以从表明共同实现一个犯罪目标的意图的行为中被推断出来。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Inchoate Crimes: Conspiracy
正确答案：A 法院不应批准无罪判决动议，因为证据足以推断出该女子和她的妹妹之间存在进口可卡因的协议 (Agreement)。
⚖️ 核心考点：共谋罪 (Conspiracy)

共谋罪的成立通常需要满足两个核心要素：

  1. 协议 (Agreement)：两人或多人之间达成实施犯罪的合意。
  2. 意图 (Intent)：具有达成协议的意图，以及实施目标犯罪的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。
  3. 公开行为 (Overt Act)：（大多数司法管辖区要求）为推进共谋而实施的某种公开行为。

关键规则：默示协议 (Implied Agreement)

MBE 考试中的常见陷阱是考生认为“协议”必须是口头或书面的明确约定。实际上，协议可以完全基于间接证据 (Circumstantial Evidence) 和当事人的行为 (Conduct) 进行推断。

🔍 案情深度解析

本题考查的是证据充分性 (Sufficiency of Evidence)。当被告律师提出“无罪判决动议” (Motion for Judgment of Acquittal) 时，法院的标准是：

“以对控方最有利的方式看待证据，理性的事实审判者是否能认定罪行成立？”

在本案中，虽然没有直接证据表明姐妹俩说了“我们一起走私毒品吧”，但以下事实足以推断出默示协议：

  • 两人一起旅行。
  • 两人使用相同的手法（缝在随身行李中）藏匿毒品。
  • 关键证据：姐姐的话 "I told my sister there were too many officers..."（我告诉过妹妹这里警察太多了）。这句话直接证明了两人之间有过关于犯罪风险的沟通和协调。
❌ 干扰项排除
A
正确。证据显示了协调一致的行动和沟通，足以让陪审团推断出“协议”的存在，这是共谋罪的核心。
B
错误。虽然持有毒品是事实，也是一种公开行为 (Overt Act)，但仅证明“持有”不足以直接证明“共谋”。共谋罪的本质是协议，而不是单纯的持有行为。选项A更准确地击中了共谋罪的定义。
C
错误。该选项声称证据仅显示了单独的持有罪。这是错误的，因为姐姐的供述揭示了两人之间的沟通（意思联络），这超越了单纯的个人犯罪，进入了共谋的范畴。
D
错误。关于退出共谋 (Withdrawal)：
1. 退出通常只能作为后续犯罪的抗辩，不能免除已经成立的共谋罪。
2. 有效的退出通常要求在犯罪实施前采取行动（如报警或阻止犯罪）。被捕后的招供不构成法律上的“退出”。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
遇到 Conspiracy（共谋）题目时，如果事实中没有明确的“握手”或“签字”协议，请寻找“协调一致的行为” (Concerted Action)。

如果两人做同样的事、有共同的利益、且有证据表明由于彼此的存在而互相壮胆或沟通，法院通常允许陪审团推断存在协议。

questions.question:
An undercover police detective told a local drug dealer that she wanted to buy cocaine but needed time to raise the necessary funds. The drug dealer said that he needed time to get the cocaine. They agreed to meet again in 10 days. An hour later, without a warrant, other officers forcibly entered the drug dealer's apartment and arrested him for attempted possession of a controlled substance.
If the drug dealer is prosecuted in a common law jurisdiction for attempted possession of cocaine, should he be convicted?

choices.a: No, because he had not taken sufficient steps toward commission of the crime.
choices.b: No, because he was illegally arrested.
choices.c: Yes, because by objective standards the undercover detective and the drug dealer had made an agreement that the dealer would obtain cocaine.
choices.d: Yes, because he unequivocally expressed his intent to obtain the cocaine.

Q84047

They agreed to meet again in 10 days. If the drug dealer is prosecuted in a common law jurisdiction for attempted possession of cocaine, should he be convicted?

一名卧底警探告诉当地一名毒贩，她想购买可卡因，但需要时间筹集必要的资金。该毒贩说他需要时间去获取可卡因。他们同意在10天后再次会面。一小时后，在没有搜查令的情况下，其他警员强行进入该毒贩的公寓，并以未遂持有受管制物品罪逮捕了他。

如果该毒贩在普通法司法管辖区因未遂持有可卡因罪被起诉，他是否应被定罪？
options:
A. No, because he had not taken sufficient steps toward commission of the crime.
不应，因为他尚未为实施犯罪采取足够的步骤。

B. No, because he was illegally arrested.
不应，因为他被非法逮捕。

C. Yes, because by objective standards the undercover detective and the drug dealer had made an agreement that the dealer would obtain cocaine.
应，因为根据客观标准，卧底警探和毒贩已达成协议，由毒贩获取可卡因。

D. Yes, because he unequivocally expressed his intent to obtain the cocaine.
应，因为他明确表达了获取可卡因的意图。
data.explanation:
Attempt


(inchoate crime)
Mens rea
(specific intent)		Actus reus
(overt act)
Common lawIntends to commit target offenseDangerous proximity test - performs act sufficiently close to completing target offense
Majority & MPCSubstantial step test - engages in conduct that exceeds mere preparation & strongly corroborates criminal intent
MPC = Model Penal Code.

Criminal liability for an attempted crime arises when a defendant:
  • has the specific intent to commit a crime
  • performs an overt act in furtherance of the target crime but does not complete it.

An overt act must go beyond mere preparation for the target crime. At common law, this requires the defendant to perform an act that is sufficiently close - in time and physical proximity - to completing the target crime (ie, dangerous proximity test). In other words, the defendant must commit an act that is indispensable to the crime's success.

Here, the drug dealer was charged with attempted possession of cocaine because he told the undercover detective that he needed time to get cocaine for her to buy. The drug dealer's statement evidences his intent to obtain cocaine. But this interaction did not amount to an overt act because it did not bring the drug dealer dangerously close to completing the crime - especially since he and the detective were not going to meet again for 10 days (Choice D). Therefore, the drug dealer should not be convicted.

(Choice B) While an illegal (eg, warrantless) arrest may lead to suppression of evidence, it will not stop a criminal prosecution or serve as a defense to the charged crime. Therefore, the dealer could be convicted despite being illegally arrested.

(Choice C) Merely agreeing to commit a crime is not an overt act under either the dangerous proximity test (common law approach) or substantial step test (modern approach).

Educational objective: Attempt requires proof that the defendant committed an overt act in furtherance of the intended crime. At common law, this requirement is met when the defendant performs an act that is dangerously close (in time and physical proximity) to completing the intended crime.

选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 9%，C选项 4%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

未遂


(未完成的罪行)
犯罪意图
(特定意图)		犯罪行为
(公开行为)
普通法意图实施目标罪行危险接近测试 - 实施的行为已足够接近完成目标罪行
多数派 & MPC实质性步骤测试 - 从事的行为已超出纯粹的准备阶段，并有力地证实了犯罪意图
MPC = Model Penal Code.

未遂犯罪的刑事责任在被告人符合以下条件时产生：
  • 具有实施某项犯罪的特定意图
  • 为促进目标罪行的完成实施了公开行为，但并未完成该罪行。

公开行为必须超出为目标罪行进行的纯粹准备。在普通法中，这要求被告人实施的行为在时间上和物理上都足够接近完成目标罪行（即dangerous proximity test）。换句话说，被告人必须实施对犯罪成功不可或缺的行为。

在本案中，该毒贩因告知卧底警探他需要时间去获取可卡因供其购买而被控未遂持有可卡因罪。该毒贩的陈述证明了他获取可卡因的意图。但这次互动并未构成公开行为，因为它没有使该毒贩危险地接近完成犯罪——尤其是因为他和警探约定10天后才再次会面（选项 D）。因此，该毒贩不应被定罪。

（选项 B）虽然非法（例如，无证）逮捕可能导致证据被排除，但这并不会中止刑事起诉，也不能作为对所控罪行的抗辩理由。因此，尽管被非法逮捕，该毒贩仍可能被定罪。

（选项 C）仅仅同意实施犯罪，在危险接近测试（普通法方法）或实质性步骤测试（现代方法）下，均不构成公开行为。

教学目标：未遂罪要求证明被告人为促进意图实施的犯罪而作出了公开行为。在普通法下，当被告人实施的行为在时间上和物理上危险地接近完成意图实施的犯罪时，这一要求即被满足。

data.htmlContent:
MBE Criminal Law

普通法下的未遂罪

正确答案：A

不应定罪，因为他尚未为实施犯罪采取足够的步骤。

核心规则：普通法未遂 (Common Law Attempt)

在普通法管辖区，未遂罪的成立必须同时满足两个要素：

  1. 特定意图 (Specific Intent)：实施目标犯罪的意图。
  2. 公开行为 (Overt Act)：超越了“纯粹准备” (Mere Preparation) 的行为。

判定标准：普通法采用危险接近测试 (Dangerous Proximity Test)。行为必须在物理上和时间上非常接近犯罪的完成，或者说该行为是完成犯罪不可或缺的一步。

本案逻辑推演
  • 意图存在：毒贩同意获取可卡因，表明他有持有的意图 (Intent)。
  • 行为不足：毒贩仅仅是口头同意，并约定“10天后”交易。他还没有联系上家、没有支付款项、没有前往交易地点。
  • 结论：在普通法严格的“危险接近测试”下，这仅仅处于准备阶段，距离犯罪完成（持有毒品）还很遥远。没有实施足够的公开行为 (Overt Act)。

为什么排除其他选项？

❌ 选项 B (非法逮捕)： 非法逮捕 (Illegal Arrest) 是程序性问题，可能导致逮捕期间获得的证据被排除（毒树之果），但它本身不是犯罪的实体抗辩理由 (Defense)，不能直接导致无罪释放。

❌ 选项 C (达成协议)： 达成协议是共谋罪 (Conspiracy) 的要素，而不是未遂罪的要素。未遂要求实际的执行行为，而不仅仅是言语上的合意。

❌ 选项 D (明确意图)： 仅有犯罪意图 (Mens Rea) 是不够的。刑法不惩罚思想，必须伴随有足够的犯罪行为 (Actus Reus)。

💡 MBE 提分技巧：
注意题目限定的司法管辖区。
  • Common Law: 要求“危险接近” (Dangerous Proximity)，门槛很高。
  • MPC (模范刑法典): 要求“实质性步骤” (Substantial Step)，门槛相对较低。
本题明确问的是 Common Law，因此必须选行为要求更严格的选项。

questions.question:
A man was planning to propose to his girlfriend, so he took her to a jewelry store to look at engagement rings. After trying on several rings, the girlfriend selected a ring that was well outside of the man's price range. The man asked the girlfriend to wait in the car while he purchased the ring. Once she exited the jewelry store, the man pulled out a gun and robbed the store.
After the robbery, the man calmly returned to the car and sat silently as the girlfriend unwittingly drove them to their house. Shortly after their arrival, a police officer knocked on their front door. Panicked, the man told the girlfriend that he had robbed the jewelry store and begged her not to open the door. Despite his pleas, the girlfriend answered the door. The man quickly hid inside their bedroom closet. When the officer asked the girlfriend where the man was, she said that the man was headed to a neighboring town. The girlfriend provided no further information to the police.
If the woman is charged as an accessory after the fact to robbery and the above evidence is presented at trial, which verdict should the jury render?

choices.a: Guilty, because the girlfriend aided the man by driving the getaway car.
choices.b: Guilty, because the girlfriend told the police officer that the man was headed to a neighboring town.
choices.c: Not guilty, because the girlfriend did not learn of the robbery until after its commission.
choices.d: Not guilty, because the girlfriend had no duty to report the robbery to the police.

一名男子正计划向女友求婚，因此带她去了一家珠宝店看订婚戒指。在试戴了几枚戒指后，女友选中了一枚远超该男子价格预算的戒指。该男子让女友在车里等他，他去购买戒指。待女友离开珠宝店后，该男子掏出枪抢劫了商店。

抢劫后，该男子冷静地回到车里，在女友不知情地开车将他们载回家时，他一言不发。他们抵达后不久，一名警察敲响了他们家的前门。该男子惊慌失措，告诉女友他抢劫了珠宝店，并恳求她不要开门。尽管他再三恳求，女友还是开了门。该男子迅速躲进卧室的衣柜里。当警察问女友该男子在哪里时，她说该男子已前往邻近的城镇。女友没有向警方提供任何进一步的信息。

如果该女子被指控为抢劫案的事后从犯，并且上述证据在审判中被呈示，陪审团应作出何种裁决？
options:
A. Guilty, because the girlfriend aided the man by driving the getaway car.
有罪，因为女友驾驶逃逸车辆帮助了该男子。

B. Guilty, because the girlfriend told the police officer that the man was headed to a neighboring town.
有罪，因为女友告诉警察该男子已前往邻近的城镇。

C. Not guilty, because the girlfriend did not learn of the robbery until after its commission.
无罪，因为女友直到抢劫案发生后才知情。

D. Not guilty, because the girlfriend had no duty to report the robbery to the police.
无罪，因为女友没有义务向警方报告抢劫案。
data.explanation:
Parties to a crime


Modern viewCommon lawDefinitionLiability
PrincipalPrincipal (first degree)Performs criminal act with requisite intent or uses innocent agent to commit criminal actTarget & foreseeable crimes
AccomplicePrincipal (second degree)Present at crime & aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory before the fact Not present at crime but aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory after the factAccessory after the factKnows principal has committed felony & helps principal avoid arrest or convictionIndependent crime
Common law liability requires conviction of principal.

A person is an accessory after the fact if he/she:
  • knew that the principal had committed a felony
  • aided or assisted the principal after the felony was committed and
  • did so for the specific purpose of helping the principal avoid apprehension or conviction.

As a result, a person who gives false information to the police to prevent the apprehension of a felon is an accessory after the fact. But a person who merely fails to report a crime is generally not.

Here, the girlfriend learned that the man had committed a felony after he told her that he had robbed the jewelry store. And though the girlfriend had no duty to report the robbery upon learning about it, she gave the police false information - that the man was headed to a neighboring town - to help him avoid apprehension (Choice D). Therefore, the jury should find the girlfriend guilty as an accessory after the fact to robbery.

(Choice A) The girlfriend may have aided the man by driving him away from the robbery. But at that time, she did not know that the man had committed the robbery. Therefore, this fact is insufficient to find the girlfriend guilty as an accessory after the fact.

(Choice C) The girlfriend did not learn of the robbery until after its commission. But upon learning of it, she lied to the police for the specific purpose of helping the man avoid arrest and is therefore an accessory after the fact.

Educational objective: An accessory after the fact is someone who knows that a person committed a felony and aids that person for the purpose of helping him/her avoid apprehension or conviction. One can be convicted as an accessory after the fact for giving the police false information to prevent apprehension of a felon, but not for merely failing to report a crime.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 92%（正确选项），C选项 5%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

犯罪参与人


现代观点普通法 (Common law)定义责任
主犯 (Principal)一级主犯 (Principal (first degree))以必要的意图实施犯罪行为，或利用无辜的代理人实施犯罪行为目标犯罪及可预见的犯罪
共犯 (Accomplice)二级主犯 (Principal (second degree))在犯罪现场，并以主犯实施犯罪的意图，帮助或鼓励主犯
事前从犯 (Accessory before the fact) 不在犯罪现场，但以主犯实施犯罪的意图，帮助或鼓励主犯
事后从犯 (Accessory after the fact)事后从犯 (Accessory after the fact)知道主犯犯下重罪，并帮助主犯逃避逮捕或定罪独立犯罪
普通法 (Common law) 上的责任要求主犯已被定罪。

一个人构成事后从犯 (accessory after the fact)，如果他/她：
  • 知道主犯犯下了重罪
  • 在重罪实施后帮助或协助了主犯 并且
  • 这样做是出于帮助主犯逃避逮捕或定罪的特定目的。

因此，向警方提供虚假信息以阻止重罪犯被逮捕的人是事后从犯。但仅仅未能报告罪行的人通常不构成事后从犯。

在本案中，女友在男子告诉她抢劫了珠宝店后，得知他犯下了重罪。尽管女友在得知抢劫案后没有义务报案，但她向警方提供了虚假信息——即该男子前往邻近的城镇——以帮助他逃避逮捕 (选项D)。因此，陪审团应裁定女友作为抢劫案的事后从犯有罪。

(选项A) 女友可能通过开车将男子带离抢劫现场而帮助了他。但在当时，她并不知道该男子实施了抢劫。因此，这一事实不足以裁定该女友为事后从犯。

(选项C) 女友直到抢劫案发生后才知晓此事。但在得知后，她为了帮助该男子逃避逮捕而向警方撒谎，因此构成事后从犯。

教学目的：事后从犯 (accessory after the fact) 是指知道他人犯下重罪，并为了帮助其逃避逮捕或定罪而提供帮助的人。向警方提供虚假信息以阻止重罪犯被逮捕可被定为事后从犯，但仅仅未能报告罪行则不能。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law / Inchoate Crimes
正确答案：B 陪审团应裁定女友有罪，因为她向警察撒谎，称该男子去了邻镇。
核心考点：事后从犯 (Accessory After the Fact)

在普通法和现代刑法中，构成事后从犯必须同时满足以下三个要素：

  • 重罪已完成 (Completed Felony)： 主犯必须已经实施了重罪。
  • 知情 (Knowledge)： 被告必须知道该重罪已经发生。
  • 协助行为 (Assistance)： 被告必须为了防止主犯被逮捕、起诉或定罪而提供协助。

本案逻辑推演

1. 犯罪意图 (Mens Rea)：
当警察敲门时，男子已经向女友坦白了抢劫事实。此时，女友已经具备了“知情”这一要素。她随后撒谎的目的明确是为了帮助男友逃避警察的抓捕。

2. 犯罪行为 (Actus Reus)：
女友对警察撒谎（称男子去了邻镇），这属于积极的协助行为（Affirmative Act）。

结论： 虽然她没有义务主动报警，但她不能主动撒谎来误导警方。这种为了掩护罪犯而撒谎的行为，完美符合 Accessory After the Fact 的定义。

为什么选项 A (开车) 错误？
虽然她确实驾驶了逃逸车辆（客观行为），但在那时她不知道抢劫已经发生。事后从犯要求在提供帮助时必须“知情”。不知情的帮助者通常被视为“无辜代理人” (Innocent Agent)，不承担刑事责任。
为什么选项 D (无义务) 错误？
这是一个经典的 MBE 干扰项。法律确实通常不惩罚单纯的“不作为” (Failure to report a crime)。如果女友只是保持沉默或拒绝开门，她可能无罪。但她选择了主动撒谎 (Commission of an act)，这就跨越了界限，构成了犯罪。
MBE 解题技巧：
区分“共犯” (Accomplice - 犯罪中) 与“事后从犯” (Accessory - 犯罪后)。
注意“知情时间点”和“主动协助行为”。

A man decided to steal a valuable coin collection from a collector's house while the collector was away. Knowing that the house had an alarm system, the man contacted the pool cleaner who worked at the house twice a week. The man offered the pool cleaner part of the proceeds from selling the coin collection if she would disarm the alarm and leave a side door unlocked so that the man could enter the house. The pool cleaner pretended to agree but then contacted the police, who immediately arrested the man.
In a jurisdiction that follows the common law and has adopted the bilateral requirement for conspiracy, what crime has the man committed?

choices.a: Attempted burglary.
choices.b: Attempted larceny.
choices.c: Conspiracy.
choices.d: Solicitation.

data.questionStem:
Q84826 A man decided to steal a valuable coin collection from a collector's house while the collector was away. Knowing that the house had an alarm system, the man contacted the pool cleaner who worked at the house twice a week. The man offered the pool cleaner part of the proceeds from selling the coin collection if she would disarm the alarm and leave a side door unlocked so that the man could enter the house. The pool cleaner pretended to agree but then contacted the police, who immediately arrested the man.

In a jurisdiction that follows the common law and has adopted the bilateral requirement for conspiracy, what crime has the man committed? 一名男子决定在收藏家外出时从其家中盗窃一套贵重的钱币收藏品。该男子知道房子里有警报系统，于是联系了每周在房子里工作两次的泳池清洁工。该男子向泳池清洁工提出，如果她能解除警报并留下一扇侧门不上锁，以便该男子进入房屋，他将分给她一部分出售钱币收藏品的收益。泳池清洁工假装同意，但随后联系了警方，警方立即逮捕了该男子。

在一个遵循普通法并采纳了共谋罪双边要求的司法管辖区，该男子犯了什么罪？
options:
A. Attempted burglary.
入室盗窃未遂罪。

B. Attempted larceny.
盗窃罪未遂。

C. Conspiracy.
共谋罪。

D. Solicitation.
教唆罪。
data.explanation:
Inchoate crimes


AttemptSpecific intent to commit crime & overt act committed in furtherance of target crime
Merges with intended crime if completed
ConspiracyAgreement entered with specific intent to commit crime & overt act committed in furtherance of agreement
No merger
SolicitationInducing or encouraging another to commit crime with specific intent that crime be committed, but solicited party need not agree
Merges with solicited crime if completed
At common law (and in most jurisdictions), solicitation is an inchoate offense that requires proof that the defendant: enticed, encouraged, or commanded another to commit a crime (eg, burglary or larceny) with the specific intent that the person commit that crime. Here, the man enticed the pool cleaner to help him steal the coin collection from the collector's house by offering to share proceeds from selling the collection with her. And the man specifically intended that the pool cleaner help him steal the coins by disarming the alarm and leaving a side door unlocked. Therefore, he committed solicitation.

(Choices A & B) Attempt occurs when a defendant (1) has the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) commits an act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) does not complete it. In this common law jurisdiction, an act must bring the defendant sufficiently close to completing the target offense. Therefore, mere preparation (eg, soliciting help to commit a crime) is not enough.

(Choice C) Conspiracy occurs when two or more persons enter an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime. The common law bilateral theory of conspiracy requires proof of at least two guilty minds-the defendant and one other conspirator. Therefore, a defendant cannot be convicted when the only other conspirator feigns agreement (as seen here).

Educational objective: Common law solicitation occurs when a defendant (1) entices, encourages, or commands another to commit a crime (2) with the specific intent that the person commit the crime.

未完成罪


未遂具有犯罪的特定意图，并为促进目标犯罪而实施了明显行为
如果完成，则与意图犯下的罪行合并
共谋为犯罪的特定意图达成协议，并为促进协议而实施了明显行为
不合并
教唆引诱或鼓励他人犯罪，具有希望该罪行被实施的特定意图，但被教唆方不必同意
如果完成，则与被教唆的罪行合并
在普通法中（以及在大多数司法管辖区），教唆罪是一种未完成罪，需要证明被告人： 引诱、鼓励或命令他人犯罪（例如，入室盗窃罪或盗窃罪），并且具有希望该人实施该罪行的特定意图。 在本案中，该男子通过提议与泳池清洁工分享出售收藏品的收益，引诱她帮助自己从收藏家家中盗窃钱币收藏品。并且，该男子有特定意图，希望泳池清洁工通过解除警报和不锁侧门来帮助他盗窃钱币。因此，他犯了教唆罪。

(选项 A 和 B) 当被告人 (1) 具有实施犯罪的特定意图，(2) 为促进该犯罪而实施了一个行为，但 (3) 未能完成犯罪时，构成未遂罪。在这个普通法司法管辖区，一个行为必须使被告人足够接近完成目标犯罪。因此，仅仅是准备行为（例如，教唆他人帮助犯罪）是不够的。

(选项 C) 当两个或两个以上的人为实施犯罪的特定意图达成协议时，构成共谋罪。普通法共谋罪的双边理论要求证明至少有两个犯罪意图——即被告人和其他一名共谋者。因此，当唯一的其他共谋者假装同意时（如本案所示），被告人不能被判共谋罪。

教学目标： 普通法中的教唆罪是指被告人 (1) 引诱、鼓励或命令他人犯罪，(2) 并且具有希望该人实施该罪行的特定意图。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

Inchoate Crimes (未完成罪)

正确答案：D (Solicitation)

本题考查教唆罪的构成要件以及与共谋罪的区别。

⚖️ 法律依据与推理

教唆罪(Solicitation)

在普通法下，教唆罪的构成要件非常直接：

  • 行为 (Actus Reus)： 引诱、鼓励、命令或请求他人实施犯罪。
  • 意图 (Mens Rea)： 具有希望该罪行被实施的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。

关键点： 教唆罪是“一经开口即构成”的犯罪。只要被告人提出了请求，无论对方是否同意，甚至对方立即拒绝，教唆罪都已经完成。

本案应用： 被告人请求泳池清洁工协助盗窃，并提供了报酬。这完全符合教唆罪的定义。

🚫 为什么不是共谋罪 (Conspiracy)？

这是本题最大的陷阱。题目明确指出该司法管辖区遵循普通法并采纳双边要求(Bilateral Requirement)。

  • 双边理论 (Bilateral Theory)： 要求至少有两人达成真正的协议。即双方都必须有犯罪的意图。
  • 本案事实： 清洁工只是“假装同意”(feigned agreement)，实际上她联系了警察。
  • 结论： 由于清洁工没有真正的犯罪意图，双方没有达成“合意”(meeting of the minds)。因此，在双边理论下，共谋罪不成立。

注：如果题目适用《模范刑法典》(MPC) 或单边理论 (Unilateral Theory)，则被告人即便独自一人有此意图，只要他认为达成了协议，也可构成共谋罪。但本题限定了普通法。

❌ 为什么不是未遂 (Attempt)？
选项 A & B 错误

未遂罪要求实施了显性行为(Overt Act)，该行为必须超过“仅仅是预备”(Mere Preparation)的阶段。

在普通法中，仅仅是寻找帮手 (Soliciting help) 通常被视为预备行为，尚未达到“危险接近”(Dangerous Proximity)完成犯罪的程度。被告人并未进入房子，也未开始实施盗窃，只是在找人帮忙，因此不构成入室盗窃或盗窃的未遂。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 当题目涉及两人“合作”犯罪，且其中一人是警方卧底或假装同意时：
  1. 首先检查题目适用的法律是Common Law还是MPC。
  2. 如果是Common Law（双边理论）：由于缺乏双方合意，不构成共谋罪，通常构成教唆罪。
  3. 如果是MPC（单边理论）：即使对方假装，被告人仍构成共谋罪。

A man and a woman were partners in an automobile leasing agency. For some time, the man had been embezzling money from the agency. The woman became suspicious and told the man that she wanted to engage an accounting firm to audit the agency's books. In a panic to prevent the audit and avoid being discovered, the man decided to have the woman killed. He contacted a professional killer and hired him to kill the woman for $10,000. A short time later, the woman died in a car crash arranged by the killer.
In addition to embezzlement, of what crime or crimes may the man properly be convicted?

choices.a: Conspiracy and murder.
choices.b: Murder.
choices.c: Solicitation and conspiracy.
choices.d: Solicitation, conspiracy, and murder.

data.questionStem:
Q84809 A man and a woman were partners in an automobile leasing agency. For some time, the man had been embezzling money from the agency. The woman became suspicious and told the man that she wanted to engage an accounting firm to audit the agency's books. In a panic to prevent the audit and avoid being discovered, the man decided to have the woman killed. He contacted a professional killer and hired him to kill the woman for $10,000. A short time later, the woman died in a car crash arranged by the killer.

In addition to embezzlement, of what crime or crimes may the man properly be convicted? 一名男子和一名女子是汽车租赁公司的合伙人。一段时间以来，该男子一直在侵吞公司的钱款。该女子起了疑心，并告诉该男子她想聘请一家会计师事务所来审计公司的账目。为了防止审计并避免被发现，该男子惊慌失措之下决定派人杀害该女子。他联系了一名职业杀手，以1万美元的价格雇佣他去杀害该女子。不久之后，该女子在杀手安排的一场车祸中丧生。

除了侵占罪之外，该男子还可能被适当定罪何种罪行？
options:
A. Conspiracy and murder.
共谋罪和谋杀罪。

B. Murder.
谋杀罪。

C. Solicitation and conspiracy.
教唆罪和共谋罪。

D. Solicitation, conspiracy, and murder.
教唆罪、共谋罪和谋杀罪。
data.explanation:
A person who unlawfully kills another with malice aforethought is principally liable for murder. But a person who did not commit that killing is equally liable for murder if he/she acted as an accomplice by (1) intentionally aiding or encouraging the principal before or during the crime (2) with the specific intent that the crime be completed. As a result, a person can become an accomplice when he/she commits either:

solicitation – by inducing or encouraging another to commit a crime with the specific intent that the crime be committed or

conspiracy – by entering an agreement with the specific intent to commit a crime and, in most jurisdictions, at least one conspirator committing an overt act in furtherance of that agreement.

Here, the man committed solicitation and conspiracy when he contacted and hired a professional killer to kill the woman—subjecting the man to accomplice liability. And since the killer successfully arranged the deadly car crash pursuant to their agreement, the man can be convicted of murder (Choice B). And though he cannot be convicted of solicitation since it merges with the solicited crime once completed (Choices C & D), he can still be convicted of conspiracy since it remains a separate offense.

Educational objective: A defendant who commits solicitation or conspiracy is often subject to accomplice liability for the encouraged crime. And if the encouraged crime is completed, the defendant can be convicted of the completed crime and conspiracy—but not solicitation since it merges with the completed crime.

Merger of inchoate & completed crimes


AttemptSolicitationConspiracy
MergerMergerNo merger
Completed crimeCompleted crimeCompleted crime

一个怀有预谋恶意非法杀害他人的人，主要对谋杀罪负责。但一个没有实施该杀人行为的人，如果其作为共犯，通过 (1) 在犯罪前或犯罪中故意协助或鼓励主犯，并且 (2) 怀有完成该犯罪的具体意图，则对谋杀罪负有同等责任。因此，当一个人实施以下任一行为时，他/她就可能成为共犯：

教唆罪——通过引诱或鼓励他人犯罪，并怀有完成该犯罪的具体意图，或者

共谋罪——通过达成协议，怀有实施犯罪的具体意图，并且在大多数司法管辖区内，至少有一名共谋者为推进该协议而实施了明显行为。

在本案中，该男子在联系并雇佣职业杀手杀害该女子时，实施了教唆罪和共谋罪——这使该男子承担共犯责任。并且，由于杀手根据他们的协议成功安排了致命的车祸，该男子可被判谋杀罪（选项B）。而且，尽管他不能被判教唆罪，因为一旦被教唆的罪行完成，教唆罪就会被吸收（选项C和D），但他仍然可以被判共谋罪，因为共谋罪仍然是一个独立的罪行。

教学目标： 实施教唆罪或共谋罪的被告通常要因被鼓励的罪行承担共犯责任。如果被鼓励的罪行完成，被告可被判已完成的罪行和共谋罪——但不能被判教唆罪，因为教唆罪会被已完成的罪行吸收。

未完成罪行与既遂罪的吸收合并


未遂罪教唆罪共谋罪
吸收合并吸收合并不吸收合并
既遂罪既遂罪既遂罪

data.htmlContent:
MBE 刑法考点解析

吸收原则与共犯责任

✅ 正确答案：A

Conspiracy and murder
（共谋罪和谋杀罪）

本题考察的是刑法中关于未完成罪（Inchoate Crimes）的吸收原则（Merger Doctrine）以及共犯责任（Accomplice Liability）。

1. 为什么构成谋杀罪 (Murder)？

虽然男子没有亲手杀人，但他雇佣了杀手。根据共犯责任（Accomplice Liability）：

  • 男子协助并鼓励（雇佣并付款）杀手犯罪；
  • 男子具有该犯罪完成的具体意图（Specific Intent）。

因此，男子对杀手实施的既遂谋杀负有同等刑事责任。

2. 为什么构成共谋罪 (Conspiracy)？

共谋罪的构成要件是：

  • 两人或多人达成犯罪协议（Agreement）；
  • 具有达成协议并实施犯罪的意图；
  • （大多数辖区要求）实施了明显行为（Overt Act）。

本案中，男子与杀手达成协议并支付报酬，符合所有要件。关键点：共谋罪是一个独立的罪行，它不与既遂罪行合并。

3. 为什么不选教唆罪 (Solicitation)？

这就是本题的核心考点——吸收原则 (Merger Doctrine)。

男子确实实施了教唆行为（Solicitation），即请求他人犯罪。但是，普通法和现代刑法规则均规定：

一旦被教唆的罪行实际完成（Completed），教唆罪即被该既遂罪行吸收（Merge）。

因此，被告不能同时被判教唆罪和既遂罪（谋杀）。教唆罪消失，只剩下谋杀罪。

📊 考点总结：吸收原则表

罪行 (Inchoate Crime) 既遂后是否吸收? (Merger?) 结果
教唆罪
Solicitation		 ✅ 是 (Merges) 只定既遂罪
未遂罪
Attempt		 ✅ 是 (Merges) 只定既遂罪
共谋罪
Conspiracy		 ❌ 否 (No Merger) 既遂罪 + 共谋罪

💡 MBE 考试技巧

记住口诀："Conspiracy never merges"（共谋罪从不吸收）。

如果你看到题目中罪行已经完成，选项中同时包含“Solicitation”（教唆）和“Completed Crime”（既遂罪），该选项通常是错误的。但如果选项是“Conspiracy”（共谋）和“Completed Crime”，这通常是正确答案。

questions.question:
A jurisdiction has the following decisional law on questions of principal and accomplice liability:
CASE A: The defendant, a hardware store owner, sold several customers a device which detects police radar and enables speeders to avoid detection. When one of the devices broke down and the speeder was arrested, he confessed that he often sped, secure in the knowledge that the device would warn him of police radar in the vicinity. Held: The defendant is guilty as an accomplice to speeding.
CASE B: The defendant told a friend that the defendant had stored some stereo equipment in a self-storage locker. He gave the friend a key and asked her to pick up the equipment and deliver it to the defendant's house. The friend complied and removed the equipment from the locker using the key. In fact, the equipment belonged to the defendant's neighbor, whose locker key the defendant had found in the driveway. Held: The defendant is guilty as a principal to burglary.
CASE C: A city council member accepted a bribe from the defendant in exchange for his vote on the defendant's application for a zoning variance. A statute prohibits the taking of bribes by public officials. Held: The defendant is not guilty as an accomplice to the city council member's violation of the bribery statute.
CASE D: The defendant, an innkeeper, sometimes let his rooms to prostitutes whom he knew to be using the rooms to ply their trade. He charged the prostitutes the same price as other guests at his inn. Held: The defendant is not guilty as an accomplice to prostitution.
A plastic surgeon agreed to remove the fingerprints from the hands of a man whom the surgeon knew to be a safecracker. The surgeon charged his usual hourly rate for the operation. Afterward, the man burglarized a bank safe and was convicted of burglary. The surgeon has been charged with burglary.
Should he be convicted or acquitted of this crime?

choices.a: Convicted on the authority of Case A.
choices.b: Convicted on the authority of Case B.
choices.c: Acquitted on the authority of Case C.
choices.d: Acquitted on the authority of Case D.

CASE C: A city council member accepted a bribe from the defendant in exchange for his vote on the defendant's application for a zoning variance. A statute prohibits the taking of bribes by public officials. Held: The defendant is not guilty as an accomplice to the city council member's violation of the bribery statute.
CASE D: The defendant, an innkeeper, sometimes lent his rooms to prostitutes whom he knew to be using the rooms to ply their trade. He charged the prostitutes the same price as other guests at his inn. Held: The defendant is not guilty as an accomplice to prostitution.
In this jurisdiction, conviction for statutory rape requires proof of the defendant's knowledge that the victim is underage. A high school student, who knew that a girl was underage, encouraged his friend, who was unaware of the girl's age, to have sex with the girl. The student has been charged with statutory rape.
Should the student be convicted or acquitted of this crime?

choices.a: Convicted on the authority of Case A.
choices.b: Convicted on the authority of Case B.
choices.c: Acquitted on the authority of Case C.
choices.d: Acquitted on the authority of Case D.

一名女子承诺向一名杀手支付10,000美元，条件是该杀手以任何无法追查到她的方式杀死她的邻居。杀手购买了一把枪并监视邻居的房屋，以寻找射杀他的机会。一天晚上，邻居在走向自己房屋时并未察觉到杀手的存在，不慎绊倒，头部撞在了门前台阶上。杀手以为邻居已失去知觉，便跑到他身边，向其胸部开了两枪。

当该女子得知邻居死亡后，她向杀手支付了10,000美元。法医鉴定，邻居在被杀手射杀时已经死亡。

以下罪行按严重程度降序排列。

该女子可被适当定罪的最严重罪行是什么？
options:
A. Murder.
谋杀罪。

B. Attempted murder.
谋杀未遂罪。

C. Conspiracy.
共谋罪。

D. Solicitation.
教唆罪。
data.explanation:
Inchoate crimes


AttemptSpecific intent to commit crime & overt act committed in furtherance of target crime Merges with intended crime if completed
ConspiracyAgreement entered with specific intent to commit crime & overt act committed in furtherance of agreement No merger
SolicitationInducing or encouraging another to commit crime with specific intent that crime be committed, but solicited party need not agree Merges with solicited crime if completed
Criminal liability is imposed equally upon:

  • principals - persons who commit a criminal act with the requisite mental state and
  • accomplices - persons who (1) intentionally aid or encourage the principal to commit a crime (2) with the specific intent that the principal complete that crime.


Both parties are liable for the encouraged crime and any crimes that occur as a natural and probable (ie, foreseeable) consequence of that crime.

Here, the woman became an accomplice when she promised to pay the hit man $10,000 to commit a murder - ie, an unlawful killing committed with malice aforethought. But even though the man shot the neighbor twice in the chest, neither the man nor the woman can be convicted of murder because the fall (not the shooting) caused the neighbor's death (Choice A). However, they can be convicted of attempted murder since the shooting was an overt act committed in furtherance of the intended but unsuccessful murder.

(Choice C) The woman could be convicted of conspiracy - an agreement entered with the specific intent to commit a crime - even though the agreed-upon murder was not completed. But the conspiracy would also create accomplice liability for the more serious crime of attempted murder.

(Choice D) The woman committed solicitation (the least serious crime) when she requested that the hit man commit a murder with the specific intent that he do so. This request also established the woman's accomplice liability for attempted murder (a more serious crime).

Educational objective: The principal commits a criminal act with the requisite mental state, while the accomplice intentionally aids or encourages the principal with the specific intent that the principal complete that crime. Both are equally liable for the encouraged crime and its natural and probable consequences.

选项正确率统计：A选项 14%，B选项 69%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

未完成罪


未遂 (Attempt)有实施犯罪的特定意图，并为促进目标犯罪而实施了明显行为。如果犯罪完成，则并入所意图的罪行。
共谋 (Conspiracy)为实施犯罪达成具有特定意图的协议，并为促进该协议而实施了明显行为。不发生并入。
教唆 (Solicitation)引诱或鼓励他人犯罪，且具有希望该罪行被实施的特定意图，但被教唆方无需同意。如果犯罪完成，则并入所教唆的罪行。
刑事责任同等地施加于：

  • 主犯 (principals) - 具备必要犯罪意图并实施犯罪行为的人以及
  • 从犯 (accomplices) - (1) 故意帮助或鼓励主犯实施犯罪，(2) 且具有希望主犯完成该罪行的特定意图的人。


双方均需对所鼓励的罪行以及作为该罪行的自然且可能（即可预见）的后果而发生的任何罪行承担责任。

在本案中，当该女子承诺支付10,000美元给杀手以实施谋杀——即一种怀有预谋恶意 (malice aforethought) 的非法杀人行为时，她就成为了从犯。但即使该男子向邻居胸部开了两枪，他和该女子都不能被判为谋杀罪，因为是摔倒（而非枪击）导致了邻居的死亡（选项A）。但是，他们可能被判为谋杀未遂罪，因为枪击是为促进意图实施但未成功的谋杀而采取的明显行为。

（选项C） 该女子可能被判为共谋罪——即为实施犯罪而达成具有特定意图的协议——即使协议约定的谋杀并未完成。但共谋也会为更严重的谋杀未遂罪产生从犯责任。

（选项D） 当该女子要求杀手实施谋杀，并具有希望他这么做的特定意图时，她就犯下了教唆罪（最不严重的罪行）。这一要求也确立了该女子对更严重的谋杀未遂罪的从犯责任。

教学目标：主犯具备必要的犯罪意图并实施犯罪行为，而从犯则在具有希望主犯完成该罪行的特定意图下，故意帮助或鼓励主犯。双方均对所鼓励的罪行及其自然且可能的后果承担同等责任。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

未遂犯与共犯责任
(Inchoate Crimes & Parties)
核心考点摘要

本题考察三个关键法律概念的交叉：

  1. 共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability)
  2. 因果关系 (Causation)
  3. 事实不能 (Factual Impossibility)
1. 为什么不是谋杀罪 (Murder)?
选项 A 错误

法律依据：谋杀罪要求被告的行为是导致受害者死亡的实际原因 (Actual Cause)。

案情分析：

  • 邻居死于意外摔倒 (Tripped and fell)。
  • 当杀手开枪时，邻居已经死亡。
  • 杀手的行为并没有缩短受害者的生命，因此缺乏因果关系 (Causation)。

既然杀手没有构成谋杀，作为共犯的女子也不能被判谋杀。

2. 为什么是谋杀未遂 (Attempted Murder)?
选项 B 正确

法律规则：

  • 特定意图 (Specific Intent)： 杀手意图杀死邻居。
  • 明显行为 (Overt Act)： 杀手开枪射击，这是实施犯罪的实质性步骤。

关键难点：事实不能 (Factual Impossibility)

虽然向尸体开枪在客观上无法导致死亡，但这属于“事实不能”。在普通法和绝大多数司法管辖区，事实不能不是未遂罪的抗辩理由。

Rule: If the facts were as the defendant believed them to be (neighbor was alive), the crime would have been committed.

女子的责任：

女子作为从犯 (Accomplice)，她雇佣并支付杀手，具有促进犯罪的特定意图。因此，她对杀手实施的“谋杀未遂”负有同等刑事责任。

3. 为什么不选共谋或教唆?
选项 C & D 排除

题目要求选择“最严重” (Most Serious) 的罪行。

  • 教唆 (Solicitation)： 通常是轻罪或较低等级重罪。且一旦进入未遂或完成阶段，教唆罪通常会并入 (Merge) 更严重的罪行中。
  • 共谋 (Conspiracy)： 虽然女子确实构成了共谋罪，但在大多数司法管辖区，未遂罪 (Attempt) 的量刑等级通常高于或等于共谋罪。更重要的是，作为共犯，她对“未遂”这一实质性结果负责，这通常被视为比单纯的协议更严重的罪行。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 刑法题中，如果看到被告向一个已经死亡的人或者不存在的目标（如稻草人）开枪：

  1. 检查因果关系 → 排除既遂犯 (Murder)。
  2. 检查主观意图 → 确认未遂犯 (Attempt)。
  3. 记住口诀："Factual impossibility is NO defense to attempt." (事实不能不阻却未遂责任)。

questions.question:
A youth and two of his friends were members of a teenage street gang. While they were returning from a club late one evening, their car collided with a car driven by an elderly woman. After an argument, the youth attacked the elderly woman with his fists and beat her to death. The youth's two friends watched, and when they saw the woman fall to the ground, they urged him to flee.
The youth was eventually apprehended and tried for manslaughter, but the jury could not decide on a verdict.
If the youth's companions are subsequently tried as accomplices to manslaughter, should they be acquitted or convicted?

choices.a: Acquitted, because the youth was not convicted of the offense.
choices.b: Acquitted, because they did not assist or encourage the youth to commit the crime.
choices.c: Convicted, because they made no effort to intervene.
choices.d: Convicted, because they urged him to flee.

data.questionStem:
Q84076

A youth and two of his friends were members of a teenage street gang. While they were returning from a club late one evening, their car collided with a car driven by an elderly woman. After an argument, the youth attacked the elderly woman with his fists and beat her to death. The youth's two friends watched, and when they saw the woman fall to the ground, they urged him to flee.

The youth was eventually apprehended and tried for manslaughter, but the jury could not decide on a verdict.

If the youth's companions are subsequently tried as accomplices to manslaughter, should they be acquitted or convicted?

一名青年和他的两个朋友是一个青少年街头帮派的成员。一天深夜，当他们从俱乐部返回时，他们的车与一名年长女性驾驶的汽车相撞。在一次争吵后，该青年用拳头袭击了这位年长女性，并将其殴打致死。该青年的两个朋友在一旁观看，当他们看到该女性倒在地上时，他们催促他逃跑。

该青年最终被逮捕并因过失杀人罪（manslaughter）受审，但陪审团未能做出裁决。

如果该青年的同伴随后作为过失杀人罪（manslaughter）的从犯受审，他们应被宣告无罪还是定罪？
options:
A. Acquitted, because the youth was not convicted of the offense.
宣告无罪，因为该青年未被定罪。

B. Acquitted, because they did not assist or encourage the youth to commit the crime.
宣告无罪，因为他们没有协助或鼓励该青年实施犯罪。

C. Convicted, because they made no effort to intervene.
定罪，因为他们没有试图干预。

D. Convicted, because they urged him to flee.
定罪，因为他们催促他逃跑。
data.explanation:
Parties to a crime


Modern viewCommon lawDefinitionLiability
PrincipalPrincipal (first degree)Performs criminal act with requisite intent or uses innocent agent to commit criminal act
AccomplicePrincipal (second degree)Present at crime & aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crimeTarget & foreseeable crimes
Accessory before the fact Not present at crime but aids/encourages principal with intent that principal commit crime
Accessory after the factAccessory after the factKnows principal has committed felony & helps principal avoid arrest or convictionIndependent crime
Common law liability requires conviction of principal.

A person becomes an accomplice by (1) intentionally aiding or encouraging another (ie, the principal) before or during a crime (2) with the specific intent that the crime be completed. But mere presence at the scene of a crime does not amount to aid or encouragement and is therefore insufficient to make a person an accomplice.

Here, the friends were tried as accomplices to manslaughter after the youth beat the elderly woman to death in front of them. Although the friends urged the youth to flee after the beating was over, they did not aid or encourage the youth before or during this crime - they only watched. And since mere presence at a crime scene does not establish accomplice liability, the friends should be acquitted.

(Choice A) In most jurisdictions, an accomplice can be convicted even if the principal was never tried for, or convicted of, the aided/encouraged crime. So, the fact that the youth (principal) was never convicted does not immunize the friends. But they should be acquitted since they did not aid or encourage the youth's crime.

(Choice C) Criminal liability only arises from a failure to act (ie, omission) if a person had a legal duty to act and could have reasonably done so. Since the friends were mere bystanders with no duty to intervene on the woman's behalf, the fact that they made no effort to do so is irrelevant.

(Choice D) Persons who aid a principal after a crime has been completed (ie, accessories after the fact) are liable for a separate offense (eg, harboring a fugitive) - not the offense committed by the principal (eg, manslaughter). And merely urging the youth to flee is not sufficient post- crime assistance to establish such liability.

Educational objective: An accomplice intentionally aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime with the specific intent that the crime be completed. But mere presence at a crime scene does not make a person an accomplice.

选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 59%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 27%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

犯罪参与人


现代观点普通法定义法律责任
正犯 (Principal)正犯 (一级) (Principal (first degree))具有必要犯罪意图实施犯罪行为，或利用无辜代理人实施犯罪行为
从犯 (Accomplice)正犯 (二级) (Principal (second degree))在犯罪现场，并怀有协助/鼓励正犯完成犯罪的意图目标犯罪及可预见的犯罪
事前从犯 (Accessory before the fact) 不在犯罪现场，但怀有协助/鼓励正犯完成犯罪的意图
事后从犯 (Accessory after the fact)事后从犯 (Accessory after the fact)知晓正犯已犯下重罪，并帮助正犯逃避逮捕或定罪独立的犯罪
普通法下的法律责任要求正犯已被定罪。

一个人成为从犯 (accomplice) 的条件是：（1）在犯罪之前或期间，故意协助或鼓励他人（即正犯），（2）并怀有希望该罪行完成的特定意图。但是，仅仅在场于犯罪现场并不构成协助或鼓励，因此不足以使一个人成为从犯。

在本案中，在该青年当着朋友们的面将年长女性殴打致死后，其朋友作为过失杀人罪 (manslaughter) 的从犯受审。尽管朋友们在殴打结束之后催促该青年逃跑，但他们在此次犯罪之前或期间并未协助或鼓励该青年——他们只是观看。由于仅仅在犯罪现场并不能确立从犯的法律责任，这些朋友应被宣告无罪。

(选项A) 在大多数司法管辖区，即使正犯从未因被协助/鼓励的罪行而受审或被定罪，从犯仍然可以被定罪。因此，该青年（正犯）从未被定罪这一事实并不能使其朋友免于起诉。但他们应被宣告无罪，因为他们没有协助或鼓励该青年的犯罪。

(选项C) 刑事责任仅在个人有法定义务作为且能合理作为但未作为（即不作为）时产生。由于这些朋友仅仅是旁观者，没有义务为该女性进行干预，因此他们没有试图干预这一事实是无关紧要的。

(选项D) 在犯罪完成之后协助正犯的人（即事后从犯，accessories after the fact）需对另一项独立的罪行（例如，窝藏逃犯）负责——而不是对正犯所犯的罪行（例如，过失杀人罪 manslaughter）负责。仅仅催促该青年逃跑，并不足以构成能确立此种法律责任的犯罪后协助行为。

教学目的：从犯 (accomplice) 是指在犯罪之前或期间，怀有希望该罪行完成的特定意图，故意协助或鼓励正犯的人。但仅仅在犯罪现场并不能使一个人成为从犯。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

刑法：共犯责任 (Accomplice Liability)
正确答案：B

应宣告无罪，因为他们没有协助或鼓励该青年实施犯罪。

核心考点：共犯的构成要件

根据普通法和现代刑法，一个人要成为从犯 (Accomplice)，必须满足以下两个条件：

  1. 行为要件 (Actus Reus)：在犯罪之前或期间 (Before or during)，协助、建议、命令或鼓励正犯 (Principal) 实施犯罪。
  2. 心理要件 (Mens Rea)：具有协助正犯的意图，并具有希望犯罪既遂的特定意图 (Specific Intent)。

关键例外：单纯在场 (Mere Presence) 不构成共犯。

本案逻辑推演
1
犯罪期间 (During the crime)：
当青年殴打受害者时，两个朋友只是“在一旁观看”(watched)。他们没有递武器，没有呐喊助威，也没有按住受害者。
结论：符合“单纯在场”规则，无共犯责任。
2
犯罪之后 (After the crime)：
朋友们催促青年逃跑 (urged him to flee)。这发生在殴打致死之后。
结论：事后的协助不能使人成为原罪行（过失杀人）的共犯。
为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (正犯未定罪)：
错误。 在现代法律中，从犯的责任是独立的。即使正犯 (Principal) 被无罪释放、未被起诉或未被确认，只要能证明犯罪事实存在且从犯进行了协助，从犯仍可被定罪。本题选 B 是因为朋友们没有协助行为，而不是因为正犯没被定罪。

选项 C (未干预)：
错误。 法律一般不惩罚“不作为” (Omission)，除非被告有特定的法定义务 (Legal Duty)（如父母对子女、合同义务等）。朋友对陌生受害者没有救助义务，因此“未干预”不构成犯罪。

选项 D (催促逃跑)：
错误。 犯罪既遂后的协助可能构成事后从犯 (Accessory After the Fact)，这通常是一个独立的罪名（如窝藏罪、妨碍司法公正），而不是原本的杀人罪。此外，仅仅口头催促逃跑通常不足以构成事后从犯（通常需要提供藏匿处、金钱或交通工具等实质帮助）。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
看到“朋友在场”的题目，首先画出时间线。
如果是事中沉默观看 = 无罪 (Mere Presence)。
如果是事后提供帮助 = 可能是事后从犯 (Accessory After the Fact)，但绝不是原罪行的共犯 (Accomplice)。

questions.question:
A man and a woman agreed to engage in sexual intercourse at a particular hotel the following night. The man, who was the son of the woman's brother-in-law, rented the hotel room for their tryst, but the woman did not show up.
In the applicable jurisdiction, a statute provides that a person commits the offense of incest when such person engages in sexual intercourse with a person whom he or she knows he or she is related to either by blood or by marriage as aunt or nephew.
Can the woman and the man properly be charged with conspiracy to commit incest?

choices.a: No, because of Wharton's Rule.
choices.b: No, because the woman did not show up at the hotel.
choices.c: Yes, because each consented to engage in sexual intercourse.
choices.d: Yes, because the man rented a hotel room.

questions.question:
A babysitter, while working one night, noticed that her next-door neighbor had left his house but the door had not closed completely behind him. The babysitter said to the 11-year-old boy she was watching, "Let's play a game. You go next door and see if you can find my laptop, which I lent to my neighbor, and bring it over here." The babysitter knew that the neighbor had a laptop and the babysitter planned to keep the laptop for herself.
The boy thought the laptop belonged to the babysitter. He went next door, found the laptop, and carried it out the front door. At that moment, the neighbor returned home and discovered the boy in his front yard with the laptop. The boy explained the "game" he and the babysitter were playing. The neighbor then took back his laptop and called the police.
What is the most serious crime for which the babysitter can be convicted?

choices.a: No crime, because the boy did not commit any crime.
choices.b: Attempted larceny, because the babysitter never acquired possession of the laptop.
choices.c: Larceny as an accomplice to the boy.
choices.d: Larceny by the use of an innocent agent.

data.questionStem:
Q84057

A babysitter, while working one night, noticed that her next-door neighbor had left his house but the door had not closed completely behind him. The babysitter said to the 11-year-old boy she was watching, "Let's play a game. You go next door and see if you can find my laptop, which I lent to my neighbor, and bring it over here." The babysitter knew that the neighbor had a laptop and the babysitter planned to keep the laptop for herself.

The boy thought the laptop belonged to the babysitter. He went next door, found the laptop, and carried it out the front door. At that moment, the neighbor returned home and discovered the boy in his front yard with the laptop. The boy explained the "game" he and the babysitter were playing. The neighbor then took back his laptop and called the police.

What is the most serious crime for which the babysitter can be convicted?

一天晚上，一名保姆在工作时注意到，她的隔壁邻居离家时，门没有完全关上。保姆对她正在照看的11岁男孩说：‘我们来玩个游戏。你去隔壁看看能不能找到我借给邻居的笔记本电脑，然后把它拿过来。’保姆知道邻居有一台笔记本电脑，并计划将这台电脑据为己有。

男孩以为笔记本电脑是保姆的。他去了隔壁，找到了笔记本电脑，并把它从前门拿了出来。就在这时，邻居回到家，发现男孩拿着笔记本电脑站在他家的前院里。男孩解释了他和保姆正在玩的‘游戏’。邻居随后拿回了他的笔记本电脑并报了警。

保姆可能被判定的最严重罪行是什么？
options:
A. No crime, because the boy did not commit any crime.
无罪，因为男孩没有犯任何罪。

B. Attempted larceny, because the babysitter never acquired possession of the laptop.
盗窃未遂，因为保姆从未占有该笔记本电脑。

C. Larceny as an accomplice to the boy.
作为男孩的共犯，犯有盗窃罪。

D. Larceny by the use of an innocent agent.
通过利用无辜的代理人犯下盗窃罪。
data.explanation:
Parties to a crime

(modern & majority approach)
PartyDefinitionLiability
PrincipalCommits criminal act with requisite mens rea or Tricks or forces another (ie, innocent agent) to commit criminal actLiable for resulting crime
AccompliceAids or encourages principal before or during crime with intent that principal commit crimeLiable to same extent as principal
Accessory after the factKnows principal has committed felony & helps principal avoid arrest or convictionLiable for independent crime (not principal's)
Larceny occurs when there is a trespassory taking and carrying away of another's personal property (actus reus) with the specific intent to permanently deprive that person of the property (mens rea). A conviction can stem from either:
  • principal liability - when the actus reus is committed by the defendant OR a person acting on the defendant's behalf without the requisite mens rea (ie, innocent agent ) or
  • accomplice liability - when the defendant intentionally aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime with the intent that the crime be completed (making both parties equally liable for the crime).

Here, the babysitter intended to steal the neighbor's laptop, but did not personally take it. Instead, she encouraged the boy to do so by prompting him to retrieve what he believed to be her laptop. His mistaken belief negated the necessary intent for larceny. Therefore, the boy did not commit larceny, and the babysitter cannot be convicted as his accomplice (Choices A & C). But the babysitter can still be convicted as a principal since she used the boy (an innocent agent) to steal the laptop.

(Choice B) Attempt occurs when a defendant (1) has the specific intent to commit a crime, (2) commits an overt act in furtherance of that crime, but (3) does not complete it. Since the larceny was completed when the boy took the laptop on the babysitter's behalf, she will be convicted of the completed crime - not attempt.

Educational objective: A defendant can be criminally liable if he/she (1) personally commits a crime or uses an innocent agent to do so (principal liability) or (2) intentionally aids or encourages the principal before or during a crime with the intent that the crime be completed (accomplice liability). But an accomplice is only liable to the same extent as the principal.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 17%，C选项 7%，D选项 71%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

犯罪的参与方

(现代及主流方法)
参与方定义法律责任
主犯 (Principal)具有必要犯罪意图实施犯罪行为，或欺骗、强迫他人（即无辜代理人）实施犯罪行为对结果犯罪负责
共犯 (Accomplice)在犯罪前或犯罪过程中，意图让主犯完成犯罪而协助或鼓励主犯与主犯承担同等责任
事后从犯 (Accessory after the fact)明知主犯已犯重罪，并帮助主犯逃避逮捕或定罪对独立的犯罪负责（而非主犯的罪行）
盗窃罪 (Larceny) 是指非法占有并移走他人个人财产（犯罪行为，actus reus），并具有永久剥夺该人财产的具体意图（犯罪意图，mens rea）。定罪可以基于以下任一情况：
  • 主犯责任 - 当犯罪行为由被告人实施，或由代表被告人行事但缺乏必要犯罪意图的人（即无辜代理人）实施时，或者
  • 共犯责任 - 当被告人在犯罪前或犯罪过程中故意协助或鼓励主犯，且意图让该罪行得以完成时（导致双方对该罪行承担同等责任）。

在本案中，保姆意图偷窃邻居的笔记本电脑，但并未亲自动手。相反，她通过唆使男孩取回他认为是她的笔记本电脑的方式来鼓励他这样做。男孩的错误认知否定了构成盗窃罪所必需的犯罪意图。因此，男孩没有犯盗窃罪，保姆也不能作为其共犯被定罪（选项A和C）。但是，保姆仍然可以作为主犯被定罪，因为她利用了男孩（一个无辜的代理人）来偷窃笔记本电脑。

（选项B）未遂犯是指被告人（1）具有实施某项犯罪的具体意图，（2）为促成该犯罪而实施了公开行为，但（3）未能完成该犯罪。由于当男孩代表保姆拿走笔记本电脑时，盗窃罪已经完成，因此她将被判决已完成的罪行，而不是未遂。

教学目的：被告人可能承担刑事责任，如果他/她（1）亲自实施犯罪或利用无辜代理人实施犯罪（主犯责任），或（2）在犯罪前或犯罪过程中，意图让罪行得以完成而故意协助或鼓励主犯（共犯责任）。但是，共犯仅在与主犯同等的程度上承担责任。

MBE 考点解析

Criminal Law: Parties to Crime
核心考点：无辜代理人 (Innocent Agent)

当被告人利用一个没有犯罪意图或没有责任能力的人（如儿童、精神病患者、不知情者）来实施犯罪行为时，法律将该被告人视为一级主犯 (Principal in the First Degree)，而不是共犯。

1. 盗窃罪的构成要件 (Elements of Larceny)

盗窃罪需要同时满足两个条件：

  • Actus Reus (犯罪行为): 非法占有并移动他人财产 (Trespassory taking and carrying away)。
  • Mens Rea (犯罪意图): 永久剥夺他人财产的意图 (Intent to permanently deprive)。

2. 为什么选 D？(法律推理)

正确答案 Larceny by use of an innocent agent

在本案中，犯罪行为和意图是分离的：

  • 男孩 (The Boy): 实施了“拿走并移动”的行为，但他被骗了，以为那是保姆的电脑。因此他没有“偷窃”的意图 (Lack of Mens Rea)。男孩是无罪的。
  • 保姆 (The Babysitter): 拥有“偷窃”的意图，但没有亲手拿电脑。

法律拟制：法律认为，利用无辜的代理人就像利用工具（如长棍或训练有素的猴子）一样。保姆通过男孩的手完成了犯罪行为。因此，保姆被视为亲自实施了盗窃 (Principal)。

3. 为什么其他选项错误？

错误 选项 A & C (共犯责任 Accomplice Liability)

共犯责任通常是衍生责任 (Derivative Liability)。要成为共犯，必须有一个有罪的主犯 (Principal)。因为男孩没有犯罪意图，他没有犯罪，所以保姆不能作为“共犯”被定罪。她就是主犯本人。

错误 选项 B (未遂 Attempt)

盗窃罪在财产被移动 (Asportation) 的那一刻即告完成。哪怕只是轻微的移动。男孩已经把电脑拿出了前门，犯罪行为已经既遂 (Completed)。邻居后来拿回电脑并不影响犯罪的成立，只影响损失的挽回。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到“利用不知情者/儿童/精神病人”实施犯罪的题目时，请立即联想 Innocent Agent 理论：

  1. 幕后操纵者是主犯 (Principal)，直接对既遂罪行负责。
  2. 如果被利用的人不知情，操纵者不是共犯 (Accomplice)。
  3. 只要被利用者完成了犯罪动作，操纵者即构成既遂，而非未遂。
© MBE Study Guide | Criminal Law

questions.question:
Four men are being tried for conspiracy to commit a series of bank robberies. Nine successful bank robberies took place during the period of the charged conspiracy. Because the robbers wore masks and gloves and stole the bank surveillance tapes, no witnesses have been able to directly identify the robbers. Some circumstantial evidence ties each of the men to the overall conspiracy.
During cross-examination, a prosecution witness testified that one of the men was in jail on other charges during the last six robberies. That man's lawyer has moved for a judgment of acquittal at the close of the government's case.
Should the motion be granted?

choices.a: No, because a conspirator is not required to agree to all of the objectives of the conspiracy.
choices.b: No, because a conspirator need not be present at the commission of each crime conspired upon.
choices.c: Yes, provided that the man has complied with the rule requiring pretrial notice of alibi.
choices.d: Yes, regardless of compliance with the alibi rule, because the government is bound by exculpatory evidence elicited during its case-in-chief.
